data.narrative:
Nyobolt is a Series B climate and energy technology company founded by Sai Shivareddy and Clare Grey, having raised $100M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA) operating in adjacent climate and energy technology segments, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Helion, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape.

Two triangulation methods apply to this stage and sector. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($100M) as a valuation proxy, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $190M. Peer-median methodology examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: KoBold Metals at $3.0B (Series C), Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B (Series C), and Amogy at $700M (Series C). The median valuation across this peer set is $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $162M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $595M. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty in peer selection and stage-adjustment assumptions. Stage-progression yields a more conservative floor, while peer-median reflects the higher valuations recently awarded to Series C peers in this sector. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to peers, capital efficiency trajectory, and near-term funding requirements.
